title.en: Name of the day of the week

description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `dayName(number)` koja broj od 1 do 7 pretvara u naziv dana na engleskom: `1` je `'Monday'`, `2` je `'Tuesday'`, ... `7` je `'Sunday'`.

Za sve ostalo vraća `'Invalid'`: brojeve van opsega (`0`, `8`, negativne) i brojeve koji nisu celi (npr. `1.5`).

Primeri:
- `dayName(1)` → `'Monday'`
- `dayName(7)` → `'Sunday'`
- `dayName(9)` → `'Invalid'`
description.en:
Write a function `dayName(number)` that converts a number from 1 to 7 into the name of the day: `1` is `'Monday'`, `2` is `'Tuesday'`, ... `7` is `'Sunday'`.

For everything else it returns `'Invalid'`: numbers out of range (`0`, `8`, negative ones) and numbers that are not whole (e.g. `1.5`).

Examples:
- `dayName(1)` → `'Monday'`
- `dayName(7)` → `'Sunday'`
- `dayName(9)` → `'Invalid'`

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function dayName` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(number)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `dayName(3)`, unutar funkcije je `number` jednako `3`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 20.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function dayName` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(number)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `dayName(3)`, inside the function `number` equals `3`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 20 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
`switch` bira jednu od više grana prema vrednosti.

- `switch (number) { ... }` uzima vrednost izraza u zagradama (ovde `number`) i poredi je redom sa svakim `case`.
- Poređenje je **strogo** (kao `===`), bez konverzije: `1` se poklapa sa `case 1`, ali `'1'` (tekst) ne bi.
- Kad se nađe poklapanje, izvršavanje počinje od tog `case` i ide dalje redom, sve dok ne naiđe na `return` ili `break`.
- `{` otvara telo `switch`-a; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 19.
text.en:
`switch` picks one of several branches by value.

- `switch (number) { ... }` takes the value of the expression in the parentheses (here `number`) and compares it in order with each `case`.
- The comparison is **strict** (like `===`), with no conversion: `1` matches `case 1`, but `'1'` (text) would not.
- When a match is found, execution starts from that `case` and continues in order, until it meets `return` or `break`.
- `{` opens the `switch` body; it is closed by `}` on line 19.

text.sr:
Prva grana: `case 1` i njen `return`.

- `case 1:` znači „ako je `number` jednako `1`“. Dvotačka otvara kod te grane.
- `return 'Monday'` vraća tekst i odmah završava funkciju, pa se ostale grane ne izvršavaju.
- Zato nije potreban `break`. Bez `return` ili `break` izvršavanje bi „propalo“ u sledeći `case` i vratilo pogrešan dan.
text.en:
The first branch: `case 1` and its `return`.

- `case 1:` means “if `number` equals `1`”. The colon opens the code of that branch.
- `return 'Monday'` returns the text and ends the function immediately, so the other branches do not run.
- That is why `break` is not needed. Without `return` or `break` execution would “fall through” into the next `case` and return a wrong day.

text.sr:
Isto za dane 2 do 7: svaki `case` je par linija (`case N:` pa `return`).

- `case 2:` do `case 7:` rade potpuno isto kao `case 1:`, samo sa drugim brojem i drugim tekstom.
- Svaki `case` ima svoj `return`, pa se izvršava najviše jedna grana.

Tok za nekoliko poziva:

```
dayName(1) → case 1 se poklapa → 'Monday'
dayName(4) → case 1, 2, 3 se ne poklapaju → case 4 se poklapa → 'Thursday'
dayName(7) → ... → case 7 se poklapa → 'Sunday'
```
text.en:
The same for days 2 to 7: each `case` is a pair of lines (`case N:` then `return`).

- `case 2:` to `case 7:` do exactly the same as `case 1:`, only with a different number and a different text.
- Every `case` has its own `return`, so at most one branch runs.

Flow for several calls:

```
dayName(1) → case 1 matches → 'Monday'
dayName(4) → cases 1, 2, 3 do not match → case 4 matches → 'Thursday'
dayName(7) → ... → case 7 matches → 'Sunday'
```

text.sr:
`default`: sve što nije nijedan `case`.

- `default:` je grana koja se izvršava kad se nijedan `case` nije poklopio.
- `return 'Invalid'` vraća tekst za sve ostalo: `0`, `8`, negativne brojeve, `1.5` (strogo poređenje: `1.5` nije `1`), tekst...
- Zato ne treba posebno proveravati opseg (`number < 1 || number > 7`): sve što nije ponuđeno u `case`-ovima automatski ide u `default`.

```
dayName(9)   → nijedan case → default → 'Invalid'
dayName(0)   → nijedan case → default → 'Invalid'
dayName(1.5) → 1.5 nije jednako nijednom → default → 'Invalid'
```
text.en:
`default`: everything that is none of the `case`s.

- `default:` is the branch that runs when no `case` matched.
- `return 'Invalid'` returns the text for everything else: `0`, `8`, negative numbers, `1.5` (strict comparison: `1.5` is not `1`), text...
- That is why the range does not need a separate check (`number < 1 || number > 7`): everything not offered in the `case`s automatically goes to `default`.

```
dayName(9)   → no case → default → 'Invalid'
dayName(0)   → no case → default → 'Invalid'
dayName(1.5) → 1.5 equals none → default → 'Invalid'
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo `switch`-a otvoreno u liniji 2.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the `switch` body opened on line 2.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: `switch` je pregledan kad ima mnogo tačno određenih vrednosti; `default` hvata sve ostalo.
note.en: `switch` is clear when there are many exactly defined values; `default` catches everything else.

text.sr:
Naziv dana se čita iz niza po indeksu, a ako ga nema, vraća se `'Invalid'`.

- `['Monday', ..., 'Sunday']` je niz sa sedam naziva. Niz se prvo pravi, pa se odmah čita jedan njegov element.
- `[number - 1]` čita element na tom indeksu. Indeksi kreću od `0`, a dani od `1`, zato se oduzima 1: `number = 1` daje indeks `0` (`'Monday'`), `number = 7` daje indeks `6` (`'Sunday'`).
- Za indeks koji ne postoji (broj van opsega) čitanje daje `undefined`. Isto važi za nepun indeks: `1.5 - 1` je `0.5`, a element na `0.5` ne postoji.
- `?? 'Invalid'` je **nullish coalescing**: vraća desnu stranu samo ako je leva `undefined` ili `null`. Zato nepostojeći dan postaje `'Invalid'`.
- `return` vraća rezultat i završava funkciju.

Tok:

```
number = 3   → indeks 2   → 'Wednesday'
number = 1   → indeks 0   → 'Monday'
number = 8   → indeks 7   → undefined → 'Invalid'
number = 0   → indeks -1  → undefined → 'Invalid'
number = 1.5 → indeks 0.5 → undefined → 'Invalid'
```
text.en:
The name of the day is read from an array by index, and if there is none, `'Invalid'` is returned.

- `['Monday', ..., 'Sunday']` is an array with seven names. The array is created first, and then one of its elements is read right away.
- `[number - 1]` reads the element at that index. Indexes start at `0`, while days start at `1`, so we subtract 1: `number = 1` gives index `0` (`'Monday'`), `number = 7` gives index `6` (`'Sunday'`).
- For an index that does not exist (a number out of range) reading gives `undefined`. The same holds for a fractional index: `1.5 - 1` is `0.5`, and there is no element at `0.5`.
- `?? 'Invalid'` is **nullish coalescing**: it returns the right side only if the left is `undefined` or `null`. That is why a nonexistent day becomes `'Invalid'`.
- `return` returns the result and ends the function.

Flow:

```
number = 3   → index 2   → 'Wednesday'
number = 1   → index 0   → 'Monday'
number = 8   → index 7   → undefined → 'Invalid'
number = 0   → index -1  → undefined → 'Invalid'
number = 1.5 → index 0.5 → undefined → 'Invalid'
```
